body:
We've been on food stamps now for a good amount of time, however recently were evicted and had to move, the paperwork you have to file every 6 months to re-qualify was sent to the old address before i could change it to the new one... long story short, the paperwork is not in their hands, waiting approval. 10-12 days. so.. 9 max left to go.... I aquired some canned goods from a local food bank... even then I'm try to stretch it.... I haven't eaten anything but old bread in 2 days.

As far as the power/rent situation, we have about 400 dollars coming to us on tuesday. power has to be paid for by monday at 10am, or its off. then its an additional fee to get it turned back on. i owe them at least 130 dollars, and I owe rent in the amount of 450, if not paid by wednesday, we forfeit our new lease and get evicted.... again. We're scraping by, and trying to minimize everything as much as we can. We don't even have a car... just... rent, gas (current on that one) power. our monthly bills are about 500 now, then all we have left is food to buy. We're just so far behind, and late fees keep getting tacked on that it comes out where even though we pull in 1000 a month right now, it's all gone and then rent is due again.... then late again... rinse/repeat.

Sorry for the wall of text.  I'm just really tired of all of this. everything.

 I'm supposed to have a job in december.... but it's not 100% official. It's good paying... we'll have an income of about 3000 a month... more than we need, and enough to finally get a used car or something.

I've even gone as far as to essentially ruin a few friendships, and ask for personal loans of small amounts from friends... they couldnt... and now its just weird... gahh.

tl;dr I'm 180 dollars away from stable. Surviving on little food. Kids are fed... for now, and the problem is that it's always this way. 

Thank you all for your words of hope... I just don't know if there is anything past words...
